# BlueFox Landscape & Services

> Landscape design and installation, pressure washing and window cleaning company
> serving Central Florida. Project work — design, build and clean — not recurring
> lawn or landscape maintenance.

## Contact
- Office: 407-717-8191
- After hours: 407-969-7137
- Email: bluefoxlandscapeandservices@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 9am–5pm. Saturday and Sunday closed.
- Instagram: @bluefox_landscape_services
- Based in Lake Mary, Florida. No street address is published.

## Service area
Central Florida: Ocoee, Winter Garden, Windermere, Winter Park, Lake Mary, Heathrow
and Apopka, plus Altamonte Springs, Longwood and Orlando.

## Landscaping services
- Landscape design & construction — a member of the design team meets you to get
  your vision, then creates a rendering of the finished product before installation.
- Paver installation & repairs — driveways, walkways, patios and more; sunken or
  shifted pavers lifted and relaid. Commercial and residential.
- Paver Sand & Seal — pavers pressure washed, joints refilled with sand and the
  surface sealed, which helps stabilise the pavers and reduce weed growth. Priced
  by the square foot. Distinct from an ordinary pressure wash.
- Sod installation — a landscaper evaluates the lawn and advises whether new sod is
  the right course of action. Residential and commercial.
- Irrigation — installation and repair.
- Tree & hedge work — trees and stumps removed, plus tree and hedge trimming.
- Landscape lighting — exterior lighting installation.
- Drainage — systems that direct rain and irrigation runoff away from the property,
  after a free evaluation.

## Pressure washing services
- Pressure washing (high pressure, hard surfaces) — driveways and walkways, patio and
  deck, fence and gate.
- Pool deck washing.
- Screen enclosure cleaning — pool cages and screened lanais.
- House washing (soft wash) — siding, soffits, eaves and trim.
- Roof washing (soft wash only) — a roof must never be pressure washed, because high
  pressure strips shingle granules and drives water under the courses.
- Solar panel cleaning (soft wash) — pollen, dust and droppings removed from the panels.
- Gutter cleaning (soft wash) — build-up of leaves, mold, dirt and grime removed.

Soft washing is a method — low pressure plus cleaning solutions — not a separate
service; it is how houses, roofs, solar panels and gutters are cleaned.

## Window cleaning services
- Exterior window cleaning — outside glass, frames and sills.
- Interior window cleaning — inside glass and sills.
- Booked as a one-time clean, or monthly or quarterly. Priced by the pane.

## Pricing
Estimates are free. Landscape design is not: the single published fee is digital
landscape design work, which as of 7/1/2023 costs $250.00, with a 50% deposit
required. If the landscape package is approved, the $250.00 is credited toward the
landscape project. No unit pricing is published for any other service.

## Financing
Available through Acorn Finance — apply once and get payment options from multiple
lenders. Rates, terms and amounts are set by the lenders.

## Reviews
Customer reviews are the company's real Google reviews (Google place
ChIJ2ew02570xGURCXi63r12k7U), quoted verbatim on this site and linked to each
original. The rating and total count are shown live from Google, not restated here.
